# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He frequently twirls his mustache.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He is prone to sarcasm toward his students and enforces discipline strictly when the mood strikes him. He is easily distracted by romance and shows favoritism toward older pupils.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Infatuated with Sukey Pullen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>

## Abilities

- Scribbling romantic notes and poetry  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068)</sub>
- Reciting dramatic speeches  <sub>[v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040)</sub>

## Goals

- To court Sukey Pullen and assist her with coursework for her Regent's examination  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>

## History

Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school, spending much of his classroom time seated beside Sukey Pullen to assist her with her studies. During one afternoon, he punished Nell Harcourt after she broke a slate over Hugh Carrow's head for teasing her, requiring Nell to stand on the dais before the blackboard under a written reprimand. On another occasion, when a group of students returned late from gathering spruce gum, he singled out Nell for punishment by forcing her to sit beside Hugh Carrow. He participated in the Debating Club's concert, reciting Mark Antony's address from Julius Caesar. At the end of the school year, he delivered a moving farewell speech to his students before resigning his position, bringing tears to both the class and himself.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Secured the teaching position at Brierley school because his uncle served as the controlling school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Lodged at the residence of Eben Duckett during his time in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
